title: WASM bindings (wasm-bindgen)
description: wasm-bindgen interface exposing: load_game(json) → GameHandle, legal_moves(state, player) → Move[], apply_move(state, move) → State, is_game_over(state) → Result. Compact serialization for state crossing the WASM boundary.
